title: A proof run is at one clean commit
statement: A proof run MUST name exactly one full commit, and every test outcome in it MUST come from a run against that commit's tree with no uncommitted change.

title: Every automated test has an outcome
statement: A proof run MUST hold a test outcome for every test record whose state is automated in the spec at its commit; a test that did not run is recorded as failed with the detail did not run, never left out.

title: An outcome names a test record that exists
statement: Every test outcome MUST name a test record that exists in the spec at the run's commit, and a proof run with an outcome for an unknown ID is refused, so a test named by a wrong ID is fixed and never silently ignored.

title: The provider's trusted signer attests the run
statement: A proof run MUST be attested by the trusted signer of the CI provider that ran it, with the commit as the attestation's subject, and a proof run without a verified attestation is no evidence.

title: The attestation store is the only home
statement: A proof run MUST NOT be written as a file in the product's own sources; its only record is the attestation the provider keeps.

title: One outcome per test record
statement: A proof run MUST hold at most one outcome per test record; when a test record's ID runs more than once, the outcome is failed if any run failed, else skipped if any was skipped, else passed.

title: A change decision names both commits
statement: A change decision MUST name the change's commit and the base branch head it was gated against, with the coverage of both, and a release decision names only its commit.

title: A refusal names every cause
statement: A refused decision MUST name each obligation that fell from designed, built or proved and each test record that did not pass, and a passed decision names no reason.

title: A release decision is attested
statement: A passed release decision MUST be attested by the provider's trusted signer with the release commit as its subject, so release qualification can verify it without trusting the CI run that produced it.

title: The same commits give the same decision
statement: Gating the same commit against the same base with the same proof run MUST give the same decision and the same reasons, in the same order.

title: Module requirements change only after resolution passes
statement: Resolution MUST change the module requirements only after it and its checks succeed, through the apply journal, so a failed or interrupted resolution leaves them as they were.

title: Resolution reads only the captured source
statement: Resolution MUST resolve the source STEGO captured, and MUST ignore any Go setting that could change it, such as a saved -overlay flag.

title: A cache holds only modules that match the module requirements
statement: A module cache MUST hold only module zips whose hashes the module requirements state, and its record MUST list each by path, version and hash.

title: A build runs offline from a recorded cache
statement: A build MUST run with the network off, from a module cache whose inventory its record names, and MUST fail when a module is missing or does not match the hash the module requirements state.

title: A build uses the archetype's Go SDK
statement: A build MUST use the Go SDK that the service's archetype pins, checked by the digest of its contents, and MUST refuse any other.

title: The same inputs give the same bytes
statement: Two builds from the same source revision, Go SDK and module cache MUST produce byte-identical executables, records and SBOMs.

title: The record names every input
statement: A build record MUST name the source revision, the Go SDK, the module cache inventory, the generation record, the digests of the executable and of every input, and the fixed build settings: CGO off, no workspace, no automatic toolchain switch, no automatic PGO, no telemetry, no source stamping, read-only modules and trimmed paths, with no setting or cache taken from the caller. It MUST NOT hold a credential or a complete environment.

title: An image comes only from a trusted build
statement: An image MUST hold only an executable whose digest a trusted build record names, on a scratch base, with an explicit CA bundle whose digest is trusted and never the host's, whether STEGO's image build made it or a CI provider built it from the generated Containerfile.

title: An image carries both SBOMs
statement: Every image MUST carry an SPDX and a CycloneDX SBOM, both written from its build record and attached as signed attestations.

title: Only the pipeline's trusted signer signs
statement: An image signature MUST be made by the trusted signer that the service's delivery pipeline names for the provider that built the image, and verification MUST refuse any other identity; which signer a provider has, and that it comes from the registry, is Delivering's rule (ST-DLV-INV04).

title: The same build gives the same image
statement: Two image builds from the same build record, executable and CA bundle MUST produce the same image digest.

title: The source snapshot is the committed tree of the revision
statement: A build's source snapshot MUST equal the tree that version control holds for the revision in every path, content and executable bit, and MUST refuse a link, a special file, a submodule, a path escape, an oversized input or an export attribute that changes or omits an input.

title: Image verification is exact
statement: Image verification MUST refuse an image that holds anything beyond the recorded executable and trust bundle in the recorded layout: an extra file, a link, a device, a changed owner or mode, unknown metadata, a changed hash or an excessive size, even when its hashes are consistent.

title: Registry transport is bounded and fails closed
statement: Every registry connection, loopback included, MUST use TLS verified under the operator's CA bundle; token and blob origins MUST be approved explicitly, at most eight each, a blob request MUST carry no credential or body, request counts, bytes, connections and time MUST be bounded, and no error MUST carry a credential, a token response or a redirect target.

title: A result folder is new, and a partial result is not a result
statement: A build, an image build and an SDK preparation MUST each start in a new work folder and write to a new result folder outside the input source, MUST never reuse an interrupted folder, and MUST leave no result when they fail.

title: Exactly one archetype
statement: A declaration MUST select exactly one archetype.

title: No undeclared field
statement: A declaration MUST NOT carry a field that STEGO's declaration format does not declare. ST-DECL-INV12 holds the settings of the selected archetype's components.

title: One document, no indirection
statement: A declaration MUST be one document in the declaration format, and MUST NOT use anchors, aliases or merge keys.

title: Bounded input
statement: A declaration MUST NOT be larger than 4 MiB, and MUST NOT nest more than 128 levels deep.

title: Entity names are unique
statement: Every entity name MUST be unique within the declaration.

title: Field names are unique in their entity
statement: Every field name MUST be unique within its entity.

title: Constraints suit the type
statement: A field's constraints MUST suit the type the field declares.

title: Collection names are unique
statement: Every collection name MUST be unique within the declaration.

title: A collection reads a declared entity
statement: A collection MUST name an entity that the same declaration declares.

title: A default suits the type
statement: A field's default MUST suit the type the field declares.

title: An experiment is accepted by name
statement: A declaration MUST NOT use a component whose stage is not ga unless it accepts that component by name, with a reason and a date.

title: An acceptance cannot outlive the component
statement: An acceptance date MUST NOT be later than the sunset date of the component it accepts.

title: An acceptance expires
statement: An acceptance holds to the end of its date in UTC. A declaration MUST NOT be accepted from the start of the next day in UTC after the date of any acceptance it holds, whatever the time zone of the machine that checks it.

title: The output folder and the CLI factory package are import paths outside the output
statement: A declaration's output folder and the factory package of the cli-application component MUST be valid Go import paths, and that factory package MUST NOT lie inside the output folder. The cli-application factory is the one stated exception to the rule that no hand-written code runs outside a fill (ST-DECL-INV72), because a CLI runs on the user's own machine with the user's credentials and reaches services only through their APIs, so it cannot bypass the server-side guarantees that the rule protects.

title: Tenancy and audit are defaults
statement: A declaration that omits tenancy MUST get pooled tenancy with the key tenant_id and the claim path tenant_id, and one that omits audit MUST get audit at level change. A declaration that says tenancy kind single or audit off MUST give a reason. Checking MUST refuse one that gives none.

title: The tenant comes from a verified claim
statement: The tenancy claim MUST be a token claim path, which is one or more claim names joined by dots, each a non-empty run of letters, digits, underscores, hyphens, colons or slashes, which names a path in the verified identity token. Checking MUST refuse a claim that does not follow this grammar, and a claim that names a request part, which is a claim whose first name is header, headers, body, request, query, path or cookie, in any letter case, such as a client header or a body field.

title: No tenant-less path
statement: A controller MUST declare tenants each. A collection MUST NOT read an entity whose tenant is system. A binding that writes a shared entity MUST run as system. Checking MUST refuse tenants none, a collection over a system entity, and a tenant binding that writes a shared entity.

title: Audit values and sensitivity are known
statement: An audit level MUST be metadata or change. An audit sink MUST be a port binding of the declaration. A field sensitivity MUST be public, pii or secret. Audit annotations MUST be a string map. Checking MUST refuse any other value.

title: The schema holds every name the declaration uses
statement: Checking MUST compile the .zed schema. Checking MUST refuse a declaration that names a resource type, a permission, a relation or a caveat parameter the schema lacks. Checking MUST refuse a schema that defines stego_floor, because the generator adds the floor marker definition stego_floor { relation marker: stego_floor } to the schema it writes, so the author never writes it.

title: A slot binding writes only declared relationships
statement: Each relation in Relationships written MUST exist in the schema and MUST belong to the resource type of an entity the service declares. Checking MUST refuse a relation that does not.

title: No bypass flag
statement: A slot or a setting MUST NOT hold a bypass flag, which is a value for a setting or a slot input that its component's schema marks as a bypass. Checking MUST refuse one under the no-bypass rule. A system principal MUST be a service-account subject the schema grants relations to: the system subject type MUST be service_account, the one subject type the authorization runtime gives a system principal; checking MUST refuse any other name, a service_account that the schema does not define or grants no relation to, and, when a binding runs as system, an authorization setting that names no system subject type.

title: Idempotency applies to create and to operations served by POST or PATCH
statement: Required on MUST include create, and MAY name patch or a custom operation served by POST or PATCH. Checking MUST refuse read, list, update or delete there, or any other operation that GET, PUT or DELETE serves, because GET, PUT and DELETE ignore the key.

title: Money is integer minor units in one currency
statement: A money field MUST be integer minor units with an ISO 4217 currency. A ledger MUST hold one currency. Each account MUST state a normal balance of debit or credit. A hot account MUST NOT state a minimum balance, because a post locks the row of an account with a limit and a hot account is never locked (decision on ST-DECL-Q14, orchestrator under the owner's delegation, 2026-11-13). Checking MUST refuse a float money field, a currency that is not an ISO 4217 code, and a hot account with a minimum balance.

title: A ledger is append-only
statement: A collection over a ledger MUST allow only create, post, void, reverse, read and list. A balance MUST be derived from entries, and the declaration format holds no stored balance, so no slot can update one. A transfer MUST have at least two entries that balance, and the generated service MUST refuse a transfer request with fewer than two entries or with entries that do not balance. A pending transfer MUST NOT change; it is voided and pended again. Checking MUST refuse update or delete on a ledger collection.

title: Modes and mixins are known
statement: Modes MUST be a subset of api, worker and controller; omitted means all. kafka-events MUST be bound together with durable-events. event-publisher MUST be accepted as a deprecated alias, with a warning. Checking MUST refuse an unknown mode and kafka-events without durable-events.

title: A controller holds a lease and iterates tenants
statement: A controller MUST declare its sources from scan and watch, a resync, its replicas and a lease TTL, and MUST run under a stored lease with a fencing token. Checking MUST refuse a controller with no lease TTL or an unknown source.

title: A declared invariant has one known emission
statement: A declared invariant MUST be unique with on and by, no_overlap with on, range and by, or sum_limit with on and parent. Checking MUST refuse any other kind and a kind that lacks its fields. A rule with no known emission MUST stay a slot.

title: Authorization fails closed
statement: When the declaration binds authorization, every entity a collection reads, other than an entity whose tenant is system, MUST declare a resource type, and every operation of every collection over such an entity MUST name a permission of that type or public with a reason. Checking MUST refuse a declaration with an entity or an operation left out, naming each; an operation is never unprotected by omission. An entity whose tenant is system MUST NOT declare a resource type or permissions, because a resource ID at the provider is tenant-qualified and such an entity has no tenant; checking MUST refuse one and say why.

title: The HTTP base path is a literal absolute path
statement: A declaration's base path MUST be empty or an absolute path of literal segments. Each segment MUST hold only ASCII letters, digits, '-', '.', '_' and '~', and MUST NOT be empty, '.' or '..'. The root is an empty base path, not '/'.

title: A unique-when-live field has one complete unique key
statement: A field that is unique when live MUST be unique or a member of a unique composite key, not both, and MUST NOT be computed. A composite key MUST hold the field, and each member MUST be unique when live with the same ordered key. A collection's upsert key MUST NOT hold a field that is unique when live.

title: Resource version metadata needs a versioned entity
statement: An entity that declares generation fields, observations, conditions, cleanup owners or cleanup targets MUST be versioned. Each of these MUST be well-formed, within its limits and not repeated. An observation field MUST be optional, writable and without a default, and MUST NOT be an upsert key or a patchable field. A versioned entity MUST NOT declare a field with a reserved revision, generation, condition or cleanup name.

title: A binding names a declared collection
statement: A slot binding MUST name a collection that the declaration declares.

title: A setting suits its component schema
statement: A component setting MUST be a map of the settings that its component's schema declares, and each value MUST suit the declared type.

title: Command names are unique
statement: Each command's name MUST be unique in its declaration.

title: A command writes only declared entities
statement: A command MUST name at least one entity it writes, and each entity it names MUST be one that the declaration declares.

title: A command binds one fill of the command slot
statement: A command MUST name exactly one fill, and that fill MUST implement the command slot.

title: A command fails closed on authorization
statement: When the declaration binds authorization, a command MUST name a resource type and a permission that the schema holds and a resource member of its request, and checking MUST refuse a command that omits any of them or names a type or a permission that the schema lacks.

title: A command writes only declared relationships
statement: Each relation in a command's Relationships written MUST exist in the schema and MUST belong to the resource type of an entity the command writes, and checking MUST refuse a relation that does not.

title: A command stages only named effects for known destinations
statement: Each effect a command names MUST name an outbox destination that a component of the active component set declares or that a worker of the declaration consumes (ST-DECL-INV66), and an effect name that is unique in the command, MUST NOT name the destination authz or audit, and, when the declaration binds authorization and a worker consumes the destination, MUST come from a command whose resource type is the consuming worker's resource type, because that worker decides each action for the staging principal too (ST-SUP-RP10-LC17); checking MUST refuse an effect that breaks this.

title: Query names are unique and differ from command names
statement: Each query's name MUST be unique in its declaration and MUST NOT be the name of a command of the declaration.

title: A query reads only declared entities
statement: A query MUST name at least one entity it reads, and each entity it names MUST be one that the declaration declares.

title: A query binds one fill of the query slot
statement: A query MUST name exactly one fill, and that fill MUST implement the query slot.

title: A query fails closed on authorization
statement: When the declaration binds authorization, a query MUST name a resource type and a permission that the schema holds, and checking MUST refuse a query that omits either or names one that the schema lacks.

title: Command and query routes are declared and do not conflict
statement: Each command MUST declare a route with the method POST and each query a route with the method GET, and each such route MUST be a valid pattern that conflicts with no other route of the service, as ST-GEN-INV28 states for the routes of components.

title: Observation names are unique and well formed
statement: Each observation's name MUST match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$ and MUST be unique in its declaration, and checking MUST refuse a name that does not, naming it.

title: An observation has a known kind and severity
statement: An observation's kind MUST be event, counter or histogram and its severity MUST be debug, info, warn or error, and checking MUST refuse any other kind or severity, naming the observation.

title: A histogram records one number with a unit
statement: A histogram MUST name exactly one value with a name in lower snake case and the unit s, ms, By or 1, and an event or a counter MUST NOT name a value; checking MUST refuse an observation that breaks this, naming it.

title: An observation's fields have declared types
statement: Each field of an observation MUST have a name in lower snake case that is unique in the observation and is none of value, trace_id, span_id, tenant, principal and operation, and MUST have one of these types: a field of an entity that the declaration declares, as Entity.field, which the probe method reads from a loaded value of that entity; an enum with one to 32 distinct values in lower snake case; bool; or a measure with the unit s, ms, By or 1 and a range min..max of integers where min is not greater than max. An observation MUST have at most eight fields. Checking MUST refuse free text, a plain int, an unknown entity or field, a measure without a unit or a range, and any other type, naming the observation and the field.

title: No private field in an observation
statement: An observation MUST NOT have a field that reads an entity field whose sensitivity is pii or secret (ST-DECL-UC05-R06), because the probe method reads that field from the loaded entity value and sends it, and checking MUST refuse one, naming the observation, the field and the entity field.

title: A metric observation has bounded fields
statement: Each field of a counter or a histogram MUST be an enum or a bool, and the number of value combinations of its fields, times two when it counts each attempt (for the stego.outcome attribute), times the number of names in its Emitted by, MUST be at most 127, because the limit of 128 series for each instrument (ST-SUP-RC17-OC17) counts the overflow series; checking MUST refuse a counter or a histogram that breaks this, naming it and the number.

title: An observation names who emits it
statement: An observation's Emitted by MUST name at least one command, query, worker, process method or slot binding (as collection.slot) that the declaration declares, each one only once, and checking MUST refuse an empty list or a name that the declaration does not declare, naming the observation and the name.

title: An observation states when it counts
statement: An observation's Counts MUST be attempt or committed, with attempt when it is omitted, and an observation that names an outcome measured MUST state Counts; checking MUST refuse any other value, and an observation with an outcome measured and no Counts, naming the observation.

title: A command's or query's refusals are unique, use known statuses and no reserved code
statement: Each refusal of a command or a query MUST have a name in lower snake case and a code matching ^[a-z][a-z0-9_.]{0,62}$, each unique in its command or query, a code other than the reserved codes internal and conflict, which the handler keeps for an unexpected error and for a conflict (ST-SUP-RC32-OC09, ST-SUP-RC32-OC10), and the status 400, 403, 404, 409, 412 or 422; checking MUST refuse a refusal that breaks this, naming the command or query and the refusal.

title: A schema change has a known kind and the values its kind needs
statement: A schema change MUST have a change ID in lower kebab case that is unique in the declaration, one of the kinds add, rename, retype, require, drop and unique, and only the values its kind takes: Field for every kind except add and drop of a whole entity; From for rename and retype; Conversion and Inverse conversion for retype, both required; Fill value for require, where it is required, and for retype and drop, where it is optional; and Definition for drop, where it is required; checking MUST refuse any other schema change, naming the change and the value.

title: A schema change agrees with the entity it changes
statement: The entity and the field of a schema change MUST agree with the declaration: for add, rename, retype and require the entity MUST declare the field; for rename the entity MUST NOT declare From; for retype From MUST NOT be the type that the field has, because a retype changes the type; for drop the entity MUST NOT declare the field, and a drop with no field MUST name an entity that the declaration does not declare; and for unique the field MUST name a declared invariant of kind unique on the entity; checking MUST refuse a schema change that breaks this, naming the change, the entity and the field (retype From: decision of the orchestrator on the security recheck of #248, 2026-11-13).

title: The schema steps move each change in order
statement: Each schema step MUST name a declared schema change, each schema change MUST have exactly one expand step, and MAY have one contract step after it, a change of kind add MUST NOT have a contract step, and no schema change MAY have no step; checking MUST refuse steps that break this, naming the change.

title: A field has at most one open schema change
statement: At most one schema change whose last step is expand MAY name a given field of an entity, as Field or as From, so two changes never move the rows of one column at the same time; checking MUST refuse a second one, naming both changes and the field.

title: A schema change with a backfill needs the controller mode
statement: A declaration that has a schema change of kind rename, retype, require or unique whose last step is expand MUST run the controller mode, in Modes or by the default all, because its backfill runs only in controller mode; checking MUST refuse a declaration that does not, naming the change and the missing mode controller, and STEGO MUST NOT add the mode itself.

title: The values of a schema change suit its field
statement: For require the field MUST be required with no default, a fill value MUST suit the type and constraints of the field, or for drop those of its Definition, and the conversion and the inverse conversion of a retype MUST be ones that the database component declares from From to the new type and back; checking MUST refuse a schema change that breaks this, naming the change and the value.

title: A retype converts every value it can meet
statement: The conversion of a retype MUST be total over the constraints of the field before the change, as the database component declares the constraints under which each conversion is total, or the change MUST declare a fill value, and its inverse conversion MUST be total over the constraints of the field after the change; checking MUST refuse a retype that breaks this, naming the change and the conversion.

title: At most 127 schema changes are open
statement: A declaration MUST have at most 127 schema changes whose last step is expand, because the backfill observations of the probe carry the change as an enum (ST-SUP-RP12-LC23); checking MUST refuse more, naming the count.

title: Worker names are unique and differ from other operation names
statement: Each worker's name MUST match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$, MUST be unique in its declaration and MUST NOT be the name of a command, a query or a controller of the declaration; checking MUST refuse a name that breaks this, naming it.

title: A worker has one known trigger
statement: A worker's trigger MUST be either every <interval>, with a duration of whole seconds, minutes or hours from 10s to 24h, or consumes <destination>, with a destination name in lower kebab case that is not authz or audit, that no component of the active component set declares and that no other worker consumes; checking MUST refuse any other trigger, naming the worker and the trigger.

title: A worker writes only declared entities
statement: A worker MUST name at least one entity it reads or writes, and each entity it names MUST be one that the declaration declares; checking MUST refuse a worker that names none or names an entity that the declaration does not declare, naming the worker and the entity.

title: A worker binds one fill of the worker slot
statement: A worker MUST name exactly one fill, and that fill MUST implement the worker slot; checking MUST refuse a worker with no fill, with two fills or with a fill of another slot, naming the worker and the fill.

title: A worker fails closed on authorization
statement: When the declaration binds authorization, a worker MUST name a resource type and a permission that the schema holds, and checking MUST refuse a worker that omits either or names a type or a permission that the schema lacks, naming the worker.

title: A worker stages only named effects for known destinations
statement: Each effect a worker names MUST name an outbox destination that a component of the active component set declares or that another worker of the declaration consumes, and an effect name that is unique in the worker, MUST NOT name authz, audit or the destination that the worker consumes itself, and, when the declaration binds authorization and a worker consumes the destination, MUST come from a worker whose resource type is the consuming worker's resource type (ST-SUP-RP10-LC17); checking MUST refuse an effect that breaks this, naming the worker and the effect.

title: A declaration with a worker runs the worker mode
statement: A declaration with a worker MUST run the worker mode, with its Modes omitted or holding worker; checking MUST refuse a declaration with a worker and Modes without worker, naming the worker and the modes.

title: A server-side application gives no factory
statement: Checking MUST refuse a declaration that gives the http-application component at 3.0.0 or later or the grpc-application component at 2.0.0 or later the setting factory_package, or a process of the grpc-processes component at 2.0.0 or later a factory_package, and its fault MUST name the component, the setting and the package and say where each part of the factory's work goes now: a background task or an event source to a worker (ST-DECL-EN25), a write to a command (ST-DECL-EN18), a read to a query (ST-DECL-EN19), a route to a command, a query or a collection, a registered gRPC method or server stream to the Method of a command or a query (ST-DECL-INV73), a client or bidirectional stream nowhere yet, because it is not supported and is refused (ST-DECL-INV75), a process's method to a process method (ST-DECL-EN26), initialization and cleanup to the generated runtime, and a log or a domain signal to an observation (ST-DECL-EN20). A declaration that pins an earlier major of one of these components and sets factory_package MUST be reported with the same text, the successor major and the fail date of the registry's supersession advisory for its digest (ST-DIS-PO01), and plan and apply MUST refuse it after that date, naming the component, its successor and the date, as ST-GEN-INV15 and ST-GEN-UC10-R03 state. The refusal names only these server-side components; the cli-application factory is the stated exception of ST-DECL-INV17. Checking MUST NOT change, move or delete the factory package.

title: A command's or query's gRPC method is declared and named once
statement: A command's Method MUST name a unary method, and a query's Method a unary method or a server stream, of a service in a proto file that the grpc-application component declares; a Method MUST be given only when that component is active, and MUST NOT be the Method of another command, query or process method; checking MUST refuse a Method that breaks this, naming the method.

title: A worker's Single and lease TTL fit its trigger
statement: A worker with an every trigger MUST have Single yes or no, yes when it is omitted, and MAY have a Lease TTL from 15s to 5m, 15s when it is omitted, only when Single is yes; a worker with a consumes trigger MUST omit Single and Lease TTL. Checking MUST refuse a worker that breaks this, naming the worker and the field.

title: Every declared gRPC method is served, and no client or bidirectional stream is declared
statement: When the grpc-application or the grpc-processes component is active, each unary method and each server stream of each service in their declared proto files MUST be the Method of exactly one command, query or process method, and no service MUST have a client stream or a bidirectional stream; checking MUST refuse a method that none of them names, naming it, and a client or bidirectional stream with a fault that names it and says that such streams are not supported yet.

title: Staging and consuming form no cycle
statement: The graph whose nodes are the destinations that workers of the declaration consume, with an edge from X to Y when the worker that consumes X names an effect for Y, MUST have no cycle; checking MUST refuse a declaration with a cycle and MUST name each worker and destination of the cycle, in order, starting from the destination that sorts first.

title: A process method binds one method of its process to one fill
statement: A process method's name MUST match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$ and MUST NOT be the name of a command, a query, a worker, a controller or another process method; it MUST name a process of the grpc-processes component, a unary method of a service in that process's proto files, and exactly one fill that implements the process method slot; checking MUST refuse a process method that breaks this, naming it.

title: A pooled service declares its tenant provisioning with its own permissions
statement: A declaration whose tenancy is pooled MUST declare its tenant provisioning, and the provisioning MUST bind authorization: it MUST name a resource type with a definition of its own, that is no subject type and no entity's resource type, and a Provision permission and a Retire permission that the schema holds, none of them declared public and none reaching a wildcard subject such as user:*; checking MUST refuse a declaration that breaks this, naming what is missing, shared, public or reached (decision on the security review of PR 253, orchestrator under the owner's delegation, 2026-11-13).

title: A declaration has at most 127 workers
statement: A declaration MUST declare at most 127 workers, so each built-in worker counter, which has the worker name as its only attribute, stays within the series limit of each instrument (ST-SUP-RC17-OC17), as ST-DECL-INV53 holds for declared metrics; checking MUST refuse a declaration with more, naming the number.

title: A command's retry count and lock timeout stay in their ranges
statement: A command's Retry on conflict MUST be a whole number from 0 to 3, and its Lock timeout a duration from 100 ms to 10 s; checking MUST refuse a declaration that breaks this, naming the command and the value.

title: A locked list has a bound from 1 to 1,000
statement: An entity's Lock at most MUST be a whole number from 1 to 1,000; checking MUST refuse another value, naming the entity and the value.

title: Idempotency values are known
statement: Fingerprint, when given, MUST be body, the fingerprint over the method, the route and the body that the runtime computes. Retention, when given, MUST be a duration greater than zero that the runtime can keep a key for, such as 24h or 48h. Checking MUST refuse any other value, and the fault MUST name the value found and what is allowed.

title: A setting with problem types needs the problem base
statement: A declaration that sets idempotency, or any other setting whose component emits problem types under the service's problem base, MUST set error_type_base. Checking MUST refuse it otherwise, with a fault at error_type_base that names the setting that needs it. The owner delegated this decision to the orchestrator (2026-11-09).

title: Authorization needs a declared pooled tenancy
statement: A declaration that binds authorization MUST also declare tenancy with kind pooled, because every resource ID at the provider is tenant-qualified (ST-SUP-RP06-LC22) and only a declared tenancy selects the component that gives each table its tenant column (ST-GEN-INV37). Checking MUST refuse an omitted tenancy and the kind single with a fault that names tenancy and says why. The owner delegated this decision to the orchestrator, who decided it on 2026-11-10 in the review of PR #181.

title: Each reference to a protected entity names its relation and permission
statement: When the service binds authorization, each field of an entity that refers to an entity with a resource type MUST name, in References, a relation that the service's compiled schema declares on the entity's own resource type for the referenced type, and a permission that it declares on the referenced resource type; checking MUST refuse a reference that leaves either out or names one that the schema does not declare, naming the field. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11 that every reference to an entity with a resource type is a relation that the runtime writes, and that a create and a move decide the permission that the declaration names for each reference.

title: Declared names have their form
statement: The service name MUST match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$, each collection name and each fill that a slot binding names MUST match ^[a-z][a-z0-9-]{0,62}$, each entity name MUST match ^[A-Z][A-Za-z0-9]{0,62}$, and each field name MUST match ^[a-z][a-z0-9_]{0,62}$, and checking MUST refuse each other name with its path and the form, whatever components are active. The orchestrator decided this on 2026-11-11 under the Product owner's delegation of that day, taking the recommended option (a) of ST-DECL-Q12, and added the slot-binding fill names in the recheck of PR 208; the service name may start with a digit, because stego init names the service after its folder.

title: One successor, of the same component or of the one that took over its port
statement: A component digest MUST have at most one successor. The successor MUST be another digest of the same component, or a digest of the component that graduated to ga and took over the port the superseded component provided; in the second case the supersession MUST say that it needs a declaration change.

title: An installation replaces nothing
statement: An installation MUST refuse a result folder that already exists, and MUST NOT change what that folder holds.

title: A failed check leaves no installation
statement: When a digest check or a signature check fails, the installer MUST leave no result folder and no temporary download.

title: A compiler artifact exists only when two isolated builds agree
statement: A compiler artifact MUST be produced only when two builds from one commit in separate trees, homes and caches give byte-identical executables, module checksums and version records; a disagreement produces no artifact.

title: A release is one immutable tag per commit with four assets
statement: A compiler release MUST be published under the tag of its full commit, immutable, holding exactly the executable, its build record, SHA256SUMS and the signature bundle; a release or a tag MUST never be replaced, and a burned tag MUST be followed by a new commit and a new qualification.

title: Only the main-branch signing job signs, and only the bytes it fetched
statement: A compiler signature MUST come only from the signing job of a successful build of the pinned CI definition at the main branch, whether a push or a dispatch of that branch started the run; that job holds the only attestation permission, fetches the build's artifact by its immutable ID, and signs only after both digests match the build job's outputs.

title: A supersession's fail date follows the stage window
statement: A supersession's fail date MUST equal the successor's release date plus the window the registry states for the component's stage, alpha 0 months, beta 3 months, ga 6 months, doubled when taking the successor needs a declaration change, unless a platform engineer shortens it; a fail date MUST NOT be later than that.

title: Every need is stated
statement: Platform requirements MUST state, with its kind and shape, every secret, configuration value, backing store, topic, identity issuer, ingress, egress destination, cluster permission and pod security level that the service's components need, which are the nine kinds of ST-VO53.

title: Requirements hold no environment values
statement: Platform requirements MUST name needs only, and MUST NOT hold a secret value, a host name, an address, a namespace or any other value that differs per environment.

title: The CI file is one pinned call
statement: A delivery pipeline MUST hold only a call to its provider's shared pipeline and to the STEGO checks, each by a pinned reference, so that a change to the pipeline is a change to a pin.

title: The pins come from the registry
statement: A delivery pipeline's pinned references and trusted signer MUST come from the registry's ci-pipeline component, so one registry change and a regeneration move a service to a patched pipeline.

title: Every provider runs every STEGO check
statement: A candidate MUST pass every STEGO check (drift, vet, test, a reproducible build, and the executable match) before its provider releases it for delivery, whichever provider built it.

title: A candidate holds the recorded executable
statement: A candidate's executable MUST be byte-identical to the executable its build record names, including an image the Konflux standard pipeline built from the generated Containerfile.

title: The Containerfile builds offline
statement: The generated Containerfile MUST build on scratch with the network off, from prefetched modules that match the service's module checksums, with the archetype's Go SDK and the settings the reproducible build uses.

title: The base holds only what the declaration derives
statement: A Kubernetes base MUST hold only resources derivable from the service's declaration, with probes from health-check and default resource requests and limits, and MUST NOT set replicas, a PodDisruptionBudget, a namespace, an image digest, a host name, an egress address or a secret value.

title: The base needs no plugin
statement: A Kubernetes base MUST build with plain kustomize, with no plugin, generator program or remote base, so any GitOps tool reads it as it is.

title: The delivery object holds no environment values
statement: A delivery object MUST name the service, its project and its base, and MUST take its destination cluster, namespace and overlay from the platform's environment files its generator lists, never from the service's declaration.

title: A fill implements one slot
statement: A fill MUST name exactly one slot of a component in the active registry, and one collection of the declaration.

title: Evidence names what it was taken against
statement: Test evidence MUST name the fill's content digest and its slot contract's digest as they were when the tests passed.

title: A sign-off signs one evidence
statement: A sign-off MUST carry a signature over the digest of the evidence it signs. When the evidence changes, the old sign-off no longer signs it.

title: A fill carries tests
statement: A fill MUST hold at least one test file. STEGO MUST record no evidence for a fill with none.

title: A fill imports only what it may
statement: Each Go file of a fill that is built into the service MUST import only its slot's contract package, the packages of the runtime library that this contract reaches, the Go standard library and the modules the declaration lists for fills. Each slot names its contract package: the generated package out/slots for a protobuf slot, which holds the contract of every protobuf slot, the generated package out/queries for the query slot, and the package of the command generator for the command slot; so the rule does not separate the contract of one protobuf slot from that of another. A test file of a fill (a file whose name ends in _test.go) MAY import any module that the project's go.mod holds. STEGO MUST record no evidence for a fill whose built files import anything else. The Product owner decided on 2026-11-11 that each slot names its contract package and that the runtime packages it reaches are admitted.

title: Output and record change as one
statement: The generated files and the record MUST change as one unit. An apply that stops part way MUST leave a journal, and plan, apply and drift MUST refuse to run until recovery completes it.

title: The input manifest agrees with its record
statement: The input manifest in a record MUST name the same declaration digest and registry reference as the record itself, and STEGO MUST refuse a record where they differ.

title: The record names the registry content that produced it
statement: The registry content digest in a record MUST be the digest of the registry content that apply read. Apply MUST refuse a plan that carries another digest, and MUST write nothing.

title: The record names the compiler that produced it
statement: The compiler build in a record MUST be the build identity of the compiler that ran the apply. Apply MUST refuse a plan that carries another, and MUST leave the record unchanged.

title: The record describes the inputs as apply found them
statement: Apply MUST refuse a plan, saved or made in the same run, when a project input, the record or a generated file changed after planning, and MUST write neither files nor the record. So a saved plan applies only to the record it was planned against, and only once.

title: Each planned path has one owner
statement: A plan MUST give each output path to exactly one generator, slot or the assembler. Planning MUST stop on a path that two of them write, and MUST save no plan.

title: A generator writes only inside its namespace
statement: Planning MUST stop when a generator returns a file outside the output namespace its component declares, or when a component that generates files declares no namespace.

title: A plan never touches hand-written code
statement: A plan MUST NOT create, change or delete a file outside the output folder, except the project files that STEGO owns, so a fill and its tests are never written by a run.

title: A failed run writes nothing
statement: When validation, a generator or the assembler fails, STEGO MUST write no generated file, no record and no saved plan.

title: Only qualified fills that fit their binding are wired
statement: Plan and apply MUST stop, and write nothing, when a fill the declaration binds is not qualified or does not fit its binding, as Extending's qualification of each bound fill reports it.

title: The architecture view comes from the run's inputs alone
statement: The architecture view MUST be derived only from the declaration, the registry parts and the wiring of the same run, and MUST NOT take any hand-written description, network data or guess.

title: The architecture view changes with the code
statement: Every run that writes generated code MUST write the architecture view with it, recorded like any generated file, so a view that no longer matches its inputs is drift.

title: The module file holds the archetype's runtime pin and no other STEGO module
statement: A generated service's module file MUST require the runtime library at exactly the version and checksum its archetype pins, and MUST require no other STEGO module and no replacement for it; a hand edit of that requirement is drift.

title: A generated service binds its declaration at build time
statement: Nothing in a generated service MAY read the declaration, scan the binary, or register code by name, struct tag or init() to decide what runs. The service's own generated code MUST construct and wire every part in a fixed order, so the declaration is bound when the code is generated and never at startup or per request.

title: Apply refuses a pin that does not stand unless overridden
statement: Plan and apply MUST stop, and write nothing, when a pinned component digest or runtime version is superseded or withdrawn and past its fail date, or when the run takes a new pin to a withdrawn digest, as Distributing's standing reports it. The author MAY override by name on the command a pin that the record already holds and that is past its fail date, and the record MUST then name each overridden pin; no override admits a new pin to a withdrawn digest, which is refused at once (ST-DIS-UC07-R03). A pin to a withdrawn digest that the record already holds stands until the withdrawal's fail date, and a lifecycle that cannot be read is not a pass.

title: A failed process writes one private failure record
statement: An assembled service that fails MUST write exactly one failure record to its error output, with a fixed stage name from the generated set and no formatted cause, panic value or stack, in one write attempt bounded by one second.

title: Every task shares one cancellation and ends before cleanup
statement: An assembled service MUST create one signal context before it constructs resources, MUST cancel every task on a signal or a task failure, MUST classify a return under cancellation as shutdown, and MUST wait for every task before deferred cleanup runs.

title: A task abort is contained
statement: When a task panics, also with a nil value or in a deferred call, or exits with Goexit, the assembled supervisor MUST stop and join its peers, MUST report the failed tasks by sorted name only, and MUST NOT let the panic value into any output.

title: Wiring is checked at assembly
statement: A background task MUST be a constructed value with a Run method whose constructor and dependencies the assembler retains, a constructor resource MUST be the service context or the selected database connection, every constructor index in the wiring (resources, tasks, error results, collections, dependencies, cleanup, primary, inner and outer middleware) MUST resolve, at most one component MUST declare primary middleware and no wrapper MUST lack a constructor, and a wiring that breaks any of these MUST fail generation with no file, never startup.

title: Every component's input check finishes before any component renders
statement: A run MUST finish every active component's input check before any component renders, and a failure in a later component MUST stop the run before rendering, so no file is written for a declaration any component refuses.

title: A constructor dependency names exactly one producer
statement: A constructor dependency MUST resolve to exactly one producer across the assembled components, by explicit metadata or by a value reference in a constructor argument; two producers of one name MUST make assembly refuse, naming the consumer, the dependency and the producers in sorted order.

title: The build target meets every active component's minimum Go version
statement: The service's Go build target MUST be at or above the minimum Go version each active component declares, checked before any generator runs; a component declares the minimum its pinned dependencies and language features need, and an unrelated component inherits no minimum.

title: The input manifest is bounded, canonical and digested one way
statement: The record's input manifest MUST list at most 1024 files by canonical relative path, MUST never list generated output or private state as an input, MUST exclude absolute paths so a moved project keeps its identity, MUST be checked against the loader's 4 MiB limit before it is saved, and its digest MUST be computed by one fixed codec.

title: A generated symbol never shadows a predeclared or startup name
statement: An import alias or a constructor's derived name in generated code MUST NOT be a Go predeclared identifier or a startup name such as main or run; the alias allocator MUST give such a path a distinct alias, and imports and fill construction MUST share one binding record.

title: A record is upgraded on the next run and decoded strictly
statement: A record written by an older compiler MUST be accepted and completed on the next apply, a change of the compiler's own identity MUST be a record change even when no output changes, and a record with an unknown field or version MUST be refused.

title: The assembler wires modes as component sets in one binary
statement: The assembler MUST wire each declared mode as a named component set registered with the mode registry of the runtime, MUST emit one entry point that selects modes by a repeatable mode flag with all as the default, and MUST NOT emit a fixed bundle or a second binary.

title: Generated concern checks are outputs a run must pass
statement: A run that emits tenant isolation, authorization, idempotency or ledger code MUST emit the isolation, authorization, idempotency and ledger checks as generated files, and the run MUST pass them before it writes the record.

title: HTTP routes of all components do not conflict
statement: The HTTP routes that the active components declare MUST be valid Go 1.22 patterns, and two routes on the same multiplexer, protected or public, MUST NOT conflict. A public route MUST NOT conflict with the protected fallback.

title: One apply at a time
statement: Only one STEGO process MAY write a project's generated files and record at a time. Apply MUST hold the project's lock while it writes, and MUST stop and write nothing when another process holds the lock.

title: A bound slot is invoked
statement: A slot binding MUST name a slot that a generator in the build invokes, so a binding cannot compile without ever running.

title: A binding names a slot of the active component set
statement: A slot binding MUST name a slot that a component of the active component set, or a mixin the declaration binds, declares.

title: A setting names an active component
statement: A component setting MUST name a component of the active component set, and each default of a setting that an active component declares MUST suit the declared type.

title: A table with rows changes only by declared schema changes, one phase for each release
statement: When the base ref has a record, the check MUST refuse a head declaration whose baseline, the stored shape with every schema step undone, is not the baseline of the base declaration; whose stored shape with only the steps after the base's undone is not the stored shape of the base declaration, field by field in full; that changes the on, the by or the where of an invariant of kind unique that the base declares; that changes the tenant, versioned, kind or generation fields of an entity of the base; that adds, by a new schema change of kind add, a field that is unique and has a default to an entity of the base; that changes, with no schema step, an index that the collections over an entity of the base give: whether a collection lists the entity, the scope and implicit fields of a collection that lists it, or an upsert key; whose schema steps do not start with the base declaration's steps in the same order and unchanged; whose schema changes of the base change other than by a fill value that a retype at expand gets; that removes a schema change the base declares; or that gives one schema change its expand step and its contract step in one release, because STEGO cannot count rows and so takes each table of the base as a table with rows (decision on ST-GEN-Q11, 2026-11-13; the index rule is the decision on ST-GEN-Q13 part 1 (b), orchestrator under the owner's delegation, 2026-11-13, until index steps exist).

title: The code of a release runs on the schema of the next release
statement: The code of each release MUST run on the schema that the migrations of the next release leave, and each of the two MUST read what the other writes, so that the old and the new release can run on one database during a rolling deploy.

title: A new database and an upgraded one reach the same schema
statement: The migrations of a release, run on a new database, MUST give the same tables, columns, types, constraints, indexes and triggers as the migrations of each earlier release run in turn on one database and then the migrations of this release.

title: A schema step waits for a running release that accepts it
statement: The check MUST refuse a head declaration with a new schema step when the record at the base ref pins a postgres-adapter version before the first version that holds ST-SUP-RC01-OC28, as the introduced_in of that output contract names it, because that release refuses a ledger longer than its own, and MUST name that version as the release to deploy first (decision on ST-GEN-Q10, 2026-11-13).

title: A declared setting selects the component it implies
statement: Generation MUST add to the active component set the infrastructure component that a declared setting implies: tenancy selects tenancy (ST-SUP-RC27), audit selects audit-log (ST-SUP-RC28), authorization selects spicedb-authz (ST-SUP-RC29), idempotency selects idempotency (ST-SUP-RC30) and a ledger selects ledger (ST-SUP-RC31), each at the version the registry pins. A component selected this way is not part of an archetype or a mixin, so the golden path rule of ST-SUP-SP01 does not apply to it; while it is not ga, the declaration MUST carry an experimental acceptance (ST-DECL-EN07) that names it and has not run out, and generation MUST refuse the declaration otherwise, with a fault that names the component, its stage and the acceptance to add. The port audit-sink is bound by the platform: no component provides it, and an active audit-log needs no provider for it in the set (ST-SUP-SP02, ST-SUP-SP03). The owner delegated this decision to the orchestrator (2026-11-09).

title: A local registry adds and never replaces
statement: A local registry MUST NOT replace a part that the common registry supplies, and MAY only add parts of its own.

title: A component writes only its own namespace
statement: A component MUST write its output only into the namespace it declares, so one component cannot overwrite another's output.

title: An experiment owns only its own port
statement: A component whose stage is not ga MUST NOT provide a port that a ga component provides, so no override can put an experiment on a golden path.

title: A mixin adds and never replaces
statement: A mixin MUST only add components and slots to the archetype it extends, and MUST NOT replace a part of it.

title: Providers of one port agree on every field
statement: Two components that provide the same port MUST put the same meaning in every field of that port, so an override cannot change what a field means.

title: A declared slot is invoked
statement: A generator in the build MUST invoke every slot that its component declares, so a declared extension point cannot be dead.

title: A ga component meets the quality bar at its digest, or is reported
statement: A component MUST be released as ga only when it holds a security review, a benchmark against a reference and a design review, each recorded at its current digest, and a reference comparison recorded at the current digest of its contract set, and a new version of a ga component MUST meet the bar again before it is released as ga. A ga component that no longer holds the bar at its current digest MUST stay ga and load, and the quality standing MUST report it below the bar and end as failed.

title: An archetype pins one Go SDK
statement: An archetype MUST pin one official Go SDK by version and contents digest, so every service on its golden path builds with the same toolchain, and a toolchain change is one registry change.

title: A component states its place in the architecture
statement: A component MUST state its layer, the part it plays in a request flow, and the side of the flow each of its ports is on, so the architecture view of every service that uses it is derived from the registry and never guessed from its generator.

title: An archetype pins one runtime library
statement: An archetype MUST pin exactly one runtime library version, by module path, version and the module checksum that the module requirements record, and every service of the archetype MUST import that version and no other STEGO module; only a new archetype version moves the pin.

title: A slot exposes a typed contract, never a framework handle
statement: A slot's contract MUST be the protobuf service it declares, and the code a component emits for the slot MUST NOT hand a fill a database handle, an ORM, a router or any other object through which the fill could step around the generated checks.

title: A component emits no static file
statement: Every file a component emits MUST vary with the declaration. A file that is byte-identical for two declarations that differ in everything the component reads, once the module path and package name are normalised, is static: it belongs in the runtime library, and the registry MUST refuse the component.

title: Every namespace is a Go import path
statement: A component's namespace MUST be a valid Go import path, a library namespace MUST end in a valid package name that is no keyword, blank or main, and both MUST be checked before rendering and never rewritten.

title: A slot contract changes only within Buf's FILE rules
statement: A change to a slot's contract under the same slot name MUST pass Buf's FILE breaking rule set against the contract last released, so every fill built against an earlier contract keeps compiling; a change that fails a FILE rule MUST take a new slot name.

title: A ga archetype carries tenancy and audit-log
statement: Every ga archetype MUST name the tenancy and the audit-log components as default concerns. A declaration MAY opt out of a default concern only with a reason, and STEGO MUST record the reason with the service, in its declaration and its generation record, and never in the registry.

title: A mixin may require another mixin
statement: A mixin MAY require another mixin. Checking MUST refuse a declaration that binds a mixin without a mixin it requires, naming both.

title: event-publisher is a deprecated alias
statement: The mixin event-publisher MUST resolve to durable-events plus kafka-events, MUST carry a sunset one ga window after the release that deprecated it, and a declaration that binds it MUST get a notice that names the two mixins and the sunset date.

title: A conformance suite includes the port's listed correctness tests
statement: A port MUST list its correctness tests by name, and its conformance suite MUST include each listed test; the registry MUST refuse a port whose suite lacks one, naming the port and the test. The port authz-decision MUST list the new-enemy test.

title: The transactional-service archetype is curated once
statement: The transactional-service archetype MUST be rest-crud plus the durable-events mixin, the controller component, the spicedb-authz and idempotency mixins and the ledger entity kind, curated once in the common registry, and a local registry MUST NOT redefine it.

title: A provider that cannot check the fencing token runs one controller
statement: A component whose provider cannot refuse a write that carries a fencing token lower than the lease holds MUST declare it, and a controller on that provider MUST run one replica and MUST NOT take over an expired lease; a replica count, a lease expiry or an operator action alone is never proof of ownership (decided 2026-10-31, ST-SUP-Q01).

title: A component version ships only with the components that take over its work
statement: A component version MAY name, under Hands work to, the components that take over work it no longer does, each with a lowest version. Loading the registry MUST refuse a component version whose Hands work to names a component that the same registry does not hold at that version or later, naming the version and each missing component, so the version cannot ship before the components that carry its work. Each component version that takes work away from its factory MUST name the components that take over that work, each at 0.1.0 or later, and loading the registry MUST refuse it when it names fewer, naming the version and each missing name: http-application at 2.0.0 or later, whose factory gets no storage (ST-SUP-RC10-OC31, ST-SUP-RC10-OC32), MUST name command and query; http-application at 3.0.0 or later, which has no factory (ST-SUP-RC10-OC35), MUST name command, query, worker and domain-probe; grpc-application at 2.0.0 or later (ST-SUP-RC07-OC18) and grpc-processes at 2.0.0 or later (ST-SUP-RC08-OC09), which have no factory, MUST name command, query, worker and domain-probe.
